summary: Signed-in users can create, read, edit and delete private text notes. Each note is visible only to its owner.

features.name: Sign in
features.description: Users sign in with an email address and password and get a session cookie.

features.name: Private notes
features.description: A signed-in user creates, lists, edits and deletes their own text notes.

requirements.text: Note endpoints require a valid session.
requirements.testable_check: GET /api/notes without a session cookie returns 401.

requirements.text: A user can only read and change their own notes.
requirements.testable_check: User B requesting GET /api/notes/<id of A's note> gets 404.

requirements.text: Note text is limited to 10 kB and stored as plain text.
requirements.testable_check: POST /api/notes with 11 kB of text returns 413.

abuse_cases.steps: Try leaked passwords against the sign-in form.
abuse_cases.mitigation: Rate limit sign-in and check passwords against breached lists.

abuse_cases.steps: Change the note id in GET /api/notes/<id>.
abuse_cases.mitigation: Look notes up by id and owner together.
